# CAD parsing dependencies

- `libredwg/`: `@mlightcad/libredwg-web` 0.7.14, used only when a DWG is uploaded. License: GPL-3.0. The license text is in `libredwg/COPYING`; corresponding source and build information: https://github.com/mlightcad/libredwg-web and https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mlightcad/libredwg-web/v/0.7.14.
- `dxf-parser/`: `dxf-parser` 1.1.2, used for ASCII DXF. License: MIT. The license text is in `dxf-parser/LICENSE`; source: https://github.com/gdsestimating/dxf-parser.

The browser parses drawing files locally. The application does not send them to a server.
